data.reason: Self-review found three defects in harness/handoff.py and cli.handoff: the complete-plan sentence describes what follows a complete plan at tdd and is wrong at review, where the first such pack was written; _section charges the budget for an 'and N more' line it discards when no entry fitted, so remaining goes negative and every later section is dropped even when it would fit; and the pack is written and read back with the locale's encoding while its bytes are compared against a recorded hash, so a non-ASCII ticket title is a UnicodeEncodeError waiting on a machine whose locale is not UTF-8. The no-plan branch has no test at all.
